awaken.where.awaken.fitting_stand: Craft it from two sticks, a copper ingot, a block of wool and three planks.
awaken.where.minecraft.crafting_table: Craft it from four planks of any wood.
awaken.where.minecraft.anvil: Craft it from three blocks of iron and four iron ingots: 31 iron in all.
awaken.where.awaken.forge: Craft it from six bricks, two iron ingots and a blast furnace.
awaken.where.minecraft.armor_stand: Craft it from six sticks and a smooth stone slab.
awaken.where.awaken.meditation_mat: Craft it from two wool with an amethyst shard between them. Amethyst grows in geodes deep underground.
awaken.where.minecraft.red_bed: Any bed counts. Craft one from three wool and three planks.
awaken.where.minecraft.smoker: A furnace or a smoker counts. A furnace takes eight cobblestone.
awaken.where.minecraft.barrel: Craft it from six planks and two wooden slabs.
awaken.where.minecraft.lectern: Craft it from four wooden slabs and a bookshelf.
awaken.where.minecraft.bookshelf: Craft each from six planks and three books.
awaken.where.minecraft.oak_fence_gate: Any fence gate counts. Craft one from four sticks and two planks.
awaken.where.minecraft.bell: Bells hang in villages. Break one with a pickaxe to take it.
awaken.where.minecraft.flower_pot: Till soil with a hoe, or plant something in a pot. A pot takes three bricks.
awaken.where.minecraft.oak_stairs: Any stairs with room to sit on them count. Six planks make four stairs.
awaken.where.minecraft.oak_fence: A fence post with a carpet, pressure plate or slab on top makes a table.
awaken.where.minecraft.resin_clump: Hit a creaking in the pale garden at night: its heart grows resin clumps on the wood around it.
awaken.where.minecraft.lantern: Craft it from eight iron nuggets around a torch.
awaken.where.minecraft.prismarine_shard: Guardians drop them, round the ocean monuments.
awaken.where.awaken.sunshard: It grows as glass spires and slivers on the Glass Steppe. Mine it.
awaken.where.awaken.frostspar: It grows on the Frost Spires and in the Shattered Highlands' fault seams. Mine it.
awaken.where.tag.wool: Shear sheep, or craft a block from four string.
